description: Na₂SnO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two Na₂SnO₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.65 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.34 Å. Sn is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-13°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Sn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Sn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-10°.
